evidence_quotes: op grond van de Waterwet en Waterschapswet partieel herzien van de legger oppervlaktewaterlichamen Geertruidenberg
rationale: The decision concerns an appeal against a waterboard decision under the Dutch Waterwet and Waterschapswet partially revising the register of surface water bodies (legger oppervlaktewaterlichamen) in Geertruidenberg, which directly falls under systemic waterboard governance (WATER).
